title: Commitment Multiplier by Hosting Term — Late-Provisioning Goodwill
content:
## Rule

The commitment multiplier of the late-provisioning goodwill follows the plan's term length as shown on the hosting plan record: a 36-month term takes 1.2, a 24-month term takes 1.1, a 12-month term takes 1.05, and any other term takes one. It multiplies the late-provisioning goodwill figure.

## Schedule

- 36-month term: 1.2
- 24-month term: 1.1
- 12-month term: 1.05
- any other term, such as the 1-month term: 1

## Example (hypothetical figure)

A late-provisioning goodwill figure of $9.40 on a 12-month plan becomes $9.40 times 1.05, $9.87; on a 1-month plan it stays $9.40.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts, goodwill for hosting plans under Web Hosting Plans that were provisioned late*
